evidence.claim: When the declared budget is one token under the unconstrained prompt, filler is dropped first; two seats were measured and each assembled prompt's contract-tokenizer count is at or under its declared budget; required anchors remain in required EVIDENCE blocks.

Stripping a required EVIDENCE block for ANCHOR_COST makes retention_check FIRE even if the id remains in prose; the unstripped twin stays silent; the detector first finds the planted present anchor (positive control).

implementation.independent_measurement: len(prompt)//4 recorded, not used as gate

negative_controls.description: After assemble_seat, remove the required EVIDENCE block for ANCHOR_COST. retention_check must fire.
A prose mention of ANCHOR_COST after the required block is removed does not satisfy retention_check.

notes: G-1 delivery of IMP-0338 per-seat context assembly. Two independent signals measured live: eviction-order / per-seat token counts, and retention-check fire on a stripped required anchor. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. cloud ok is not consulted.
question: Implement tools/council/context.py building each participant's prompt from its partition, role, history and evidence within a declared token budget, with a documented eviction order. Falsifiable question: when the budget forces eviction, what is dropped first, and can a participant lose the very evidence it is required to weigh?

residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0274 (elastic recruitment) and IMP-0298 (budget governor) are not delivered in this worktree. context.py accepts a SeatSpec and a declared per-seat budget rather than reading CouncilSpec.budgets or a recruited-seat object. Vendor tokenizers (tiktoken / provider count) are not the contract tokenizer.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: After IMP-0298 lands, pass the governor's remaining token allowance into assemble_seat and re-run probe1. After IMP-0274 lands, assemble a recruited seat with the same partition as an original seat and compare prompts.

reviewer.method: positive control on present_required_ids, then strip ANCHOR_COST, assert FIRE, unstripped twin silent
reviewer.obligation: A required anchor stripped from the assembled prompt must make retention_check fire; silence is trusted only after the detector finds a planted present token.
